Find exposed credentials and verify authoritative analysis without manufacturing a green result.

[[secret-scan]]
== Bounded secret scanning

*`secret-scan` · scanner · enforcing*

Redacted working-tree and history scans with checksum-pinned Gitleaks, real detector controls and Rust/shell supplements.

*Assurance boundary:* Full-history default; complete ancestry required. Fast PR mode requires security-owner approval.

[[secrets]]
== Private-key material

*`secrets` · policy-gate · enforcing*

Detect PEM/OpenSSH private-key material in the working tree.

*Assurance boundary:* Narrow detector, not a replacement for full-history secret scanning.

* link:../../actions/secrets-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]

[[vaulted-tokens]]
== Vaulted token format

*`vaulted-tokens` · policy-gate · enforcing*

Enforce the estate token-wrapper representation policy.

*Assurance boundary:* A format check is not proof that credentials are valid, secret or rotated.

* link:../../actions/vaulted-tokens-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]

[[sonarcloud-result]]
== Authoritative SonarCloud receipt

*`sonarcloud-result` · receipt-verifier · enforcing*

Verify the newest official-app result for an exact repository and commit.

*Assurance boundary:* Does not run analysis; missing/pending/skipped/API failures cannot pass. Requires checks: read and existing app coverage.

* link:../../actions/sonarcloud-result-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]
